purpose.summary: This program generates mailing-label reports ('Mala-Direta') for customers. It reads from an indexed customer master file (CADMDR) within a user-specified code range, formats address labels (name, address, city, state, ZIP), writes them to a temporary indexed file (CADTMP), and then calls a print routine (DYIMPR) to produce the report.

ACCEPT ... FROM ESCAPE KEY for keyboard navigation

Dynamic indexed file access with START/READ NEXT

Latin-1 / CP850 encoded screen characters (Û, ß, Ü, É, º, etc.)
COPY statements for file record layouts (CADMDR.CPY, CADTMP.CPY)
verdict.notes: The file uses IBM CP850/CP437 box-drawing characters in screen definitions, typical of Brazilian PC-based COBOL applications from the 1990s. The program is part of a larger application suite (DY prefix naming convention). COPY files (CADMDR.CPY, CADTMP.CPY) are not included, so field-level details of the master and temp files are inferred from context. The 'online-cics' label is not accurate in the CICS sense — this is a screen-based interactive batch/online program using Micro Focus or similar screen I/O, not CICS.
